scope: Run only the authorized 2 ms read-only case. The frozen v5 helper/runner also accept 1 ms and 0.5 ms for a separately authorized future repeat. Preserve the v4 9-second action and all other physics/drive settings. No production/vendor changes, training, FPS, or 830xx use.

acceptance: Unique contact_probe_runs_v5 output/log/exit paths; never overwrite prior artifacts.

Host/MJWarp cone=elliptic and impratio=1 checks pass; contact mu=.8; Newton contact pipeline remains active.

Preserve actual runner exit code and source hash checks. No follow-on parameter runs without further authorization.

followup_authorization.scope: After the completed v5 2 ms case, run exactly two sequential read-only repeats using the frozen v5 helper and runner: dt=1 ms then dt=0.5 ms. Do not run other treatments.
followup_authorization.treatment: kf=10000 N*s/m, elliptic cone, impratio=1, mu=0.8, same assets, seed, initial state, 1 s settle + 8 s action, PI gains/cap and all other settings unchanged; only physics dt changes.
followup_authorization.yaw_convergence: Compare final-1-second yaw for 1 ms versus 0.5 ms; pass when abs(yaw_1ms-yaw_0.5ms) <= max(0.01 rad/s, 0.10*abs(yaw_0.5ms)).
followup_authorization.tc_check: At 0.5 ms, report whether every positive sampled solreffriction time constant exceeds 2*dt=0.001 s; zero and negative values retain their documented semantics and are not counted as positive time constants.
followup_authorization.no_changes: Do not modify v5 helper/runner, production/vendor source, or train; no GPU run beyond these two authorized cases.
